_doc: US-local Decision Day (final regular-season day) per season; drives the R1 playoff filter (docs/spikes/E1-playoffs.md). 2020 additionally excludes the MLS-is-Back knockout window. ADD EACH NEW SEASON AS SOON AS THE LEAGUE PUBLISHES ITS CALENDAR — this is not optional bookkeeping. Corrected 2026-08-03 (T-281): a missing season does NOT 'degrade safely'. It used to make every date of that season count as regular season, which would have entered playoff fixtures into the write-once anchored record. rs_filter now REFUSES to classify an unconfigured season from its guard horizon (the earliest Decision Day ever configured, currently Oct 6 from 2019) onward, ingest skips those fixtures, and the daily canary raises as soon as a season with fixtures has no entry here. Consequence of leaving it blank: the record simply stops accruing for that season after early October.

neutral_site_windows._doc: MLS-is-Back group stage (counted as RS) was played at a neutral venue (Disney).
